definitions.explanation: A piece of wood, paper, or other material bearing writing, used as a sign, label, or notice.
A card used in traditional Japanese card games such as karuta or hanafuda.
A paper or wooden charm distributed at temples and shrines, believed to offer divine protection.

notes:
A versatile word appearing in many compound words related to signs, labels, cards, and religious items. Read as ふだ as a standalone word, but as さつ in the word for banknote (⟦お{札|さつ}→お札：19147_osatsu⟧).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{名|な}{札|ふだ}→名札：12338_nafuda⟧: name tag
- ⟦{値|ね}{札|ふだ}→値札：09532_nefuda⟧: price tag
- {表|おもて}{札|ふだ}: door sign; signboard
- ⟦{切|き}り{札|ふだ}→切り札：18024_kirifuda⟧: trump card (also figurative)
- ⟦{花|はな}{札|ふだ}→花札：22650_hanafuda⟧: hanafuda (Japanese flower cards)
- {入|い}り{札|ふだ}: bidding; tender
- ⟦お{札|ふだ}→お札：06190_ofuda⟧: talisman, charm (with honorific お)

KANJI READINGS:
- ふだ: tag, card, charm (the native Japanese reading)
- さつ: banknote (Sino-Japanese reading) — see separate entry for ⟦{札|さつ}→札：02153_satsu⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ラベル→ラベル：00348_raberu⟧: label — a loanword used specifically for adhesive labels on products
- ⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧: card — loanword for modern cards (credit card, membership card)
- ⟦タグ→タグ：11034_tagu⟧: tag — loanword used in computing and for clothing tags
